purpose: Explicit separation between model metadata, source license evidence and verified runtime artifact readiness.
execution_rule: A weights-required backend may execute only from verified_installed or verified_remote_asset with immutable revision, SHA-256 and applicable license verification.
planning_rule: Not-ready artifacts may remain visible for planning/benchmarking but are never silently executed.
persistence_rule: Runtime artifact state is operational metadata; it never mutates scholarly Corpus.
